problem.title: Matrix

semantics: Line 1: integer a, 0<=a<=10^9 (exponent attested from the public English statement). Line 2: digit string s, 1<=|s|<=4000. Unique integer: number of (x<=y, z<=t) whose rectangle sum of s_i*s_j equals a; the sum factorises as (s_x+..+s_y)*(s_z+..+s_t), so the answer is the number of ordered pairs of substrings whose digit sums multiply to a. Oracle: interval-sum counts for the divisors d of a with d, a/d <= 9|s|; a=0 gives 2*c0*T-c0^2 with T=|s|(|s|+1)/2. Independently checked by literal rectangle enumeration on the product matrix and a full big-integer autocorrelation histogram with a complete divisor scan.
